summary.headline: Astrology of Letters and Messengers
summary.text: Astrological interpretation of letters based on the horoscope, midheaven, planetary configurations, and zodiac signs. The text describes how the Moon, Jupiter, Mercury, Venus, Saturn, and Mars affect the letter’s contents, author, messenger, and omens, then begins sign-by-sign readings with Aries through Leo.
